quests.title: One corner, on its own
quests.ask: Write `go_around_corner()`: from the middle of a side, walk to the corner, pick its gem, and end one step along the next side, facing along it.
quests.nudge: Where it ends is where the next call starts. Picture both calls before you write it.

quests.title: Two corners in a row
quests.ask: Call it twice. The second call should pick up where the first one stopped and clear the next corner too.
quests.nudge: If the second corner goes wrong, look at where the first call leaves the robot.

quests.title: All the way home
quests.ask: Go round the whole block and finish where you started, facing east.
